output.english_question: Under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, can our bank recover a fee at loan closure if that fee had previously been forgiven when the personal loan was sanctioned?
sub_queries: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions fee forgiveness loan closure recover fee
personal loan sanctioned fee forgiven can bank recover at prepayment closure
RBI UCB responsible business conduct directions foreclosure prepayment charge fee forgiveness
premises: A fee related to closure/prepayment is being considered for recovery.
That same fee was previously forgiven at the time the personal loan was sanctioned.
The question is whether recovery of a previously forgiven fee at closure is permitted under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions.
